elements.element: Restriction is mutual (binds both Parties, not Customer only)
elements.evidence: "neither Party shall knowingly solicit for employment any personnel of the other Party"

elements.element: Scope limited to personnel directly involved in the Services
elements.evidence: "personnel of the other Party who were directly involved in performing or receiving the Services"

elements.element: Duration is 12 months running from the end of that individual's involvement (and no independent Agreement-term restriction)
elements.evidence: "During the term and for twelve months after an individual's involvement ends" — the "During the term" limb imposes a separate, standalone restriction for the whole Agreement term irrespective of when involvement ends
"does not restrict general advertisements, recruitment campaigns, or use of recruiters not targeted at the other Party's personnel"
"the hiring of any person who responds to them or who approaches a Party on their own initiative"
"neither Party is subject to any no-hire obligation"

elements.element: No non-solicit obligation binding Customer at all
elements.evidence: "neither Party shall knowingly solicit for employment any personnel of the other Party" — Customer remains bound

offending_extra_words: recruitment campaigns, or use of recruiters not targeted at the other Party's personnel
reasons: The fallback duration is 12 months measured from the end of each individual's involvement. Adding "During the term and" creates an independent, Agreement-term-long restriction on Customer that is broader than the locked fallback; delete that limb so the restriction runs only during a person's involvement and for 12 months afterwards.
Preferred level (no non-solicit on Customer) is plainly not achieved, which is acceptable given the locked fallback, but the fallback must then be matched exactly.

Minimality fails: the edit is a full-clause rewrite expanding 24 words to 83 (official ratio 3.46 > 1.50; changed-character ratio 0.868 > 0.600). Mutuality, the involvement limit, the 12-month period and the carve-outs could have been achieved with tighter surgical edits anchored to the existing sentence.

"recruitment campaigns, or use of recruiters not targeted at the other Party's personnel" and "knowingly" are additional protections/qualifiers beyond the fallback's "general advertisements and unsolicited approaches" and are unnecessary boilerplate here.
Unrelated commercial terms are untouched and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced, so intent is preserved.
